name: Fire Shield
components: M (a bit of phosphorus or a firefly)
effectSummary: For 10 minutes, wispy flames surround you, shedding bright light for 10 feet and dim light for another 10 feet; you can dismiss them as an action. Choose a warm shield or chill shield. A warm shield gives resistance to cold damage and deals 2d8 fire damage to a creature within 5 feet whenever it hits you with a melee attack. A chill shield gives resistance to fire damage and deals 2d8 cold damage under the same condition.

components: M (a platinum-plated dragon scale, worth at least 500 gp)
effectSummary: Surround one creature in range, including yourself, with a silvery field that sheds dim light for 5 feet. On later turns you can use a bonus action to move the field to another creature within 60 feet of the field.

name: Flame Arrows
effectSummary: Touch a quiver of arrows or bolts. A ranged weapon hit using ammunition drawn from it deals an extra 1d6 fire damage; the magic ends on that ammunition whether the attack hits or misses. The spell ends after twelve pieces of ammunition have been drawn. Each slot level above 3rd increases the number of affected pieces by two.

effectSummary: For the duration, your speed increases by 20 feet and your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. A creature or unattended object takes 1d6 fire damage when you move within 5 feet of it, but no creature or object can take this damage more than once per turn. Each slot level above 3rd adds 5 feet to the speed increase and 1d6 to the fire damage.

name: Flame Strike
effectSummary: A 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder in range is struck by divine fire. Creatures inside make Dexterity saves, taking 4d6 fire plus 4d6 radiant damage on a failure or half on a success. Each slot level above 5th adds 1d6 to either the fire or radiant portion, chosen by you.

name: Flaming Sphere
components: M (a bit of tallow, a pinch of brimstone, and a dusting of powdered iron)
effectSummary: Create a 5-foot-diameter fiery sphere in an unoccupied space within range. A creature ending its turn within 5 feet makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. As a bonus action, move the sphere up to 30 feet; if you ram it into a creature, that creature makes the save and the sphere stops for the turn. The sphere can move over barriers up to 5 feet high and jump pits up to 10 feet wide, ignites unattended flammable objects, and sheds bright light for 20 feet and dim light for another 20. Each slot level above 2nd adds 1d6 damage.

name: Flesh to Stone
components: M (a pinch of lime, water, and earth)
effectSummary: One visible flesh-bodied creature in range makes a Constitution save. On a failure it is restrained as it begins turning to stone. At the end of each of its turns while restrained it repeats the save; three successes end the spell, while three failures petrify it for the duration, with successes and failures tracked until either reaches three. If physically broken while petrified, it retains corresponding deformities if restored. If you maintain concentration for the full minute, the petrification lasts until removed.

name: Flock of Familiars
effectSummary: Temporarily summon three familiars using find familiar's rules and form options; all must be celestials, fey, or fiends of the same chosen type. If you already have a familiar from find familiar or similar means, summon one fewer. These familiars can communicate telepathically with you and share their visual or auditory senses while within 1 mile. A familiar can deliver a touch-range spell normally, but only one familiar can deliver a touch spell per turn. Each slot level above 2nd summons one additional familiar.

name: Fly
components: M (a wing feather from any bird)
effectSummary: A willing creature you touch gains a 60-foot flying speed for the duration. When the spell ends, it falls if still aloft unless it can stop the fall. Each slot level above 3rd lets you target one additional creature.

name: Fog Cloud
effectSummary: Create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. It spreads around corners and heavily obscures its area until the spell ends or a wind of at least 10 miles per hour disperses it. Each slot level above 1st increases the radius by 20 feet.

name: Forbiddance
components: M (a sprinkling of holy water, rare incense, and powdered ruby worth at least 1,000 gp)
effectSummary: Ward up to 40,000 square feet of floor space and 30 feet above it for 1 day. Creatures cannot teleport into the area, enter it through portals, or access it by planar travel through the Astral Plane, Ethereal Plane, Feywild, Shadowfell, plane shift, or similar means. Choose any of celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead; a chosen creature entering for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there takes 5d10 radiant or necrotic damage, chosen when cast. You may set a password whose speaker takes no damage upon entering. The area cannot overlap another forbiddance. Casting it in the same place every day for 30 days makes it last until dispelled, consuming the material components on the final casting.

name: Forcecage
effectSummary: Create an immobile invisible force prison as either a cage up to 20 feet per side with 1/2-inch bars spaced 1/2 inch apart, or a solid box up to 10 feet per side that blocks matter and spells. Creatures wholly inside are trapped; creatures only partly inside or too large to fit are pushed outward until completely outside. A trapped creature cannot leave by nonmagical means. To escape by teleportation or interplanar travel, it first makes a Charisma save; on a failure the attempted spell or effect is wasted. The prison also extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocking ethereal travel, and cannot be dispelled by dispel magic.

name: Foresight
effectSummary: For 8 hours, a willing creature you touch cannot be surprised and has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws, while attacks against it have disadvantage. The spell ends immediately if you cast foresight again before its duration expires.

name: Fortune's Favor
components: M (a white pearl worth at least 100 gp, which the spell consumes)
effectSummary: Give yourself or one willing visible creature latent luck for 1 hour. Before the spell ends, when that creature makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, it can end the spell on itself to roll one additional d20 and choose which d20 to use. Alternatively, when an attack is made against it, it can end the spell to roll a d20 and choose between its roll and the attacker's roll. If the original roll had advantage or disadvantage, the extra d20 is rolled after that has been resolved. Each slot level above 2nd lets you target one additional creature.

components: M (a leather strap, bound around the arm or a similar appendage)

It can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape nonmagical restraints such as manacles or a grapple. Being underwater imposes no penalties on its movement or attacks.

effectSummary: Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 cold damage on a failure or half on a success. The cold also freezes nonmagical liquids in the area that are not being worn or carried. Each slot level above 1st adds 1d8 damage.

name: Galder's Speedy Courier
components: M (25 gold pieces, or mineral goods of equivalent value, which the spell consumes)
effectSummary: Summon an untouchable Small air elemental carrying an open 3-foot-cube chest. You may fill the chest and name a living creature you have seen or can identify by a body sample. Closing the lid sends the elemental and chest to that creature; if the target is on another plane or protected from magical location, the contents instead return to your feet. The target knows the chest's contents and remaining duration before deciding whether to open it, and only that target can retrieve items. The elemental and chest vanish when time expires, the chest is emptied, or the target sends it back; unretrieved contents then return to your feet. With an 8th-level slot, the recipient may be on another plane.

name: Galder's Tower
components: M (a fragment of stone, wood, or other building material)
effectSummary: Conjure a sturdy two-story round or square tower for 24 hours. Each 10-foot-tall story covers up to 100 square feet and is connected by ladder and hatch; for each story choose a bedroom, study, dining room, lounge, washroom, observatory, or empty room. The interior stays warm and dry, and conjured furnishings vanish if removed. When the spell ends, creatures and nonconjured objects inside appear safely outside and the tower disappears. Recasting while active extends it 24 hours; casting daily in the same place and configuration for one year makes it permanent. Each slot level above 3rd adds one story.

name: Gaseous Form
components: M (a bit of gauze and a wisp of smoke)
effectSummary: Transform a willing nonincorporeal creature and its worn or carried gear into mist for up to 1 hour, ending early if it reaches 0 HP. Its only movement is a 10-foot flying speed; it can occupy another creature's space, hover even while incapacitated, pass through tiny openings, and treats liquids as solid surfaces. It has resistance to nonmagical damage and advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saves. It cannot speak, manipulate or use objects, attack, or cast spells, and its carried objects cannot be dropped or otherwise interacted with.

name: Gate
components: M (a diamond worth at least 5,000 gp)
effectSummary: Create a 5-to-20-foot-diameter, one-way-from-each-front portal linking a visible unoccupied space within 60 feet to a precise location on another plane for up to 1 minute. Anything entering a portal's front appears at the nearest unoccupied space by the other portal. Planar rulers can prevent such portals within their domains. When casting, you may speak one specific creature's true name; if it is on another plane, the far portal opens near it and pulls it through to your side, but gives you no control over it.

name: Geas
effectSummary: Give one visible creature that understands you a command to perform or avoid a course of action. It makes a Wisdom save or is charmed for 30 days. You can dismiss the spell as an action, and remove curse, greater restoration, or wish also ends it. A 7th- or 8th-level slot lasts 1 year; a 9th-level slot lasts until ended by one of those methods.

components: M (a pinch of salt and one copper piece placed on each of the corpse’s eyes, which must remain there for the duration)
effectSummary: Touch a corpse or other remains. For 10 days it does not decay and cannot become undead. Time spent under this spell also does not count against time limits for spells that can later restore the creature to life.

name: Giant Insect
effectSummary: Transform up to ten centipedes, three spiders, five wasps, or one scorpion within range into the corresponding giant creatures for up to 10 minutes. They obey your verbal commands, act on your turn in combat, and use the published giant-creature statistics. A transformed creature returns to normal when the spell ends, it reaches 0 HP, or you dismiss its transformation as an action. The DM may allow analogous insects using an appropriate giant stat block.

The target rises up to 20 feet and remains suspended for up to 10 minutes. It can move horizontally only by pushing or pulling against fixed surfaces. On your turn you can change its altitude by up to 20 feet; if you are the target this is part of your movement, otherwise it costs your action and the target must remain in range. When the spell ends, an airborne target floats gently to the ground.

For 1 hour it sheds colored bright light for 20 feet and dim light for another 20; completely covering it with opaque material blocks the light. name: Lightning Arrow
effectSummary: The next ranged weapon attack you make before the spell ends transforms its ammunition or thrown weapon into lightning. Each slot level above 3rd adds 1d8 to both damage effects.

components: M (a bit of fur from a bloodhound)

The spell fails to find a specific creature currently in a different form, such as from polymorph, and cannot locate any target if running water at least 10 feet wide blocks a direct path.

effect: You touch a willing creature who isn’t wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target’s base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.

name: Mage Hand
effectSummary: Create a spectral hand at a point within 30 feet for 1 minute. It disappears if more than 30 feet from you or if you cast the spell again. As an action, you can move it up to 30 feet and use it to manipulate objects, open unlocked doors or containers, stow or retrieve items from open containers, or pour out a vial. It cannot attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

name: Magic Circle
components: M (holy water or powdered silver and iron worth at least 100 gp, which the spell consumes)
effectSummary: Create a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder for 1 hour and choose one or more of celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead. Chosen creatures cannot willingly enter by nonmagical means, must make a Charisma save to enter by teleportation or planar travel, have disadvantage on attacks against targets inside, and cannot charm, frighten, or possess targets inside. You may reverse the circle so chosen creatures cannot leave and creatures outside receive the protection instead. Each slot level above 3rd adds 1 hour to the duration.

name: Magic Jar
components: M (a gem, crystal, reliquary, or some other ornamental container worth at least 500 gp)
effectSummary: Your body becomes catatonic while your soul enters the spell's container. From the container you perceive normally but cannot move or react; your only action is to project your soul up to 100 feet either back to your body, ending the spell, or into a visible humanoid not protected from possession. That target makes a Charisma save; on a failure you possess its body and its soul is trapped in the container, while on a success it resists and is immune to your possession attempts for 24 hours. While possessing, use the host's statistics but retain your alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and your own class features; you cannot use the host's class features. You can return to the container as an action if within 100 feet. If the host dies, make a Charisma save against your own spell DC to return to the nearby container or die. If the container is destroyed or the spell ends, your soul returns to your living body only if it is within 100 feet; otherwise you die. Any trapped host soul likewise returns only if its body is alive and within 100 feet. The container is destroyed when the spell ends.

name: Magic Mouth
components: M (a small bit of honeycomb and jade dust worth at least 10 gp, which the spell consumes)
effectSummary: Implant a spoken message of up to 25 words, taking up to 10 minutes to deliver, into a visible unattended object within 30 feet. Define a visual or audible trigger condition that occurs within 30 feet of the object. When triggered, a magical mouth appears and speaks the message in your voice and volume; you decide whether the spell then ends or remains to repeat whenever the trigger recurs. The trigger can be as general or detailed as you like so long as it relies on observable visual or audible conditions.

effectSummary: Imbue one to three pebbles for 1 minute. You or another creature can throw one or fire it from a sling as a ranged spell attack; a thrown stone has 60-foot range. A different attacker uses your spellcasting ability modifier for the attack instead of its own. On a hit the stone deals 1d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier bludgeoning damage, then loses the spell whether the attack hit or missed. Recasting ends the spell on any previously affected stones.

effectSummary: Increase gravity in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered within 60 feet until the start of your next turn. Creatures in the sphere when cast make Constitution saves, taking 2d8 force damage and having their speed halved until the end of their next turn on a failure, or half damage with no speed reduction on a success. Until your next turn, moving or picking up an unattended object in the sphere requires a Strength check against your spell save DC. Each slot level above 1st adds 1d8 damage.

name: Major Image
effectSummary: Create an illusory object, creature, or visible phenomenon no larger than a 20-foot cube at a visible point within 120 feet. It can include convincing sound, smell, and safe temperature, but cannot deal damage or impose harmful sensory effects. While within range, you can use an action to move and naturally animate the image and alter its sounds. Physical interaction reveals its insubstantial nature. A creature can use an action for an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC; on success it recognizes the illusion, sees through it, and perceives its other sensory traits as faint. With a 6th-level-or-higher slot, the illusion lasts until dispelled without concentration.

name: Mass Polymorph
effectSummary: Transform up to ten visible creatures for up to 1 hour. An unwilling target makes a Wisdom save; an unwilling shapechanger succeeds automatically. Each target becomes a beast you have seen whose CR is no greater than that target's CR, or half its level if it has no CR. The beast form replaces its game statistics, including mental ability scores, but it retains its own HP, alignment, and personality and gains temporary HP equal to the beast's HP. It reverts when those temporary HP are gone, when it dies, or when the spell ends. While transformed, it is limited by the beast's body, cannot speak or cast spells, and its gear melds into the form and cannot be used.

components: M (a snake’s tongue and either a bit of honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil)
effectSummary: Give a reasonable sentence-or-two suggestion to up to twelve visible creatures within 60 feet that can hear and understand you; creatures immune to charm are unaffected. You may include a triggering condition for a later action during the duration. An obviously harmful suggestion negates the spell for that target. A 7th-level slot lasts 10 days, 8th lasts 30 days, and 9th lasts 1 year and 1 day.

name: Maximillian's Earthen Grasp
components: M (a miniature hand sculpted from clay)
effectSummary: Create a Medium earthen hand in a visible unoccupied ground space within 30 feet. As an action, make the hand crush its restrained target for another Strength save and 2d6 bludgeoning damage, half on success. A restrained creature can use an action for a Strength check against your spell save DC to escape. As an action, you can move the hand or make it reach for a different creature, releasing any current target.

name: Meld into Stone
effectSummary: Use your movement to merge yourself and carried gear into a stone object or surface large enough to contain you for up to 8 hours. You leave no nonmagical sensory trace, cannot see outside, have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to hear outside, remain aware of time, and can cast spells on yourself. You can leave only through the entry point using movement. Minor damage to the stone does not harm you; partial destruction or reshaping that no longer contains you expels you for 6d6 bludgeoning damage, while complete destruction or transmutation expels you for 50 bludgeoning damage. An expelled creature falls prone in the nearest unoccupied space to the entry point.

name: Meteor Swarm
effectSummary: Choose four visible points within 1 mile. Each point erupts in a 40-foot-radius sphere that spreads around corners. Creatures in a sphere make Dexterity saves, taking 20d6 fire plus 20d6 bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success; a creature in overlapping spheres is affected only once. The spell damages objects and ignites unattended flammable objects.

name: Mighty Fortress
components: M (a diamond worth at least 500 gp, which the spell consumes)
effectSummary: Raise a stone fortress from an empty 120-foot square of visible ground within 1 mile, harmlessly lifting creatures in the area. It has four 20-by-20-foot, 30-foot-tall corner turrets linked by 80-foot walls, up to four outer doors, and a furnished three-story 50-foot-square keep whose rooms are at least 5 feet wide. It supplies a daily nine-course banquet for up to 100 people and 100 invisible servants that obey designated creatures like unseen servants. Conjured furnishings and food crumble if removed. Stone sections have AC 15, 30 HP per inch of thickness, and immunity to poison and psychic damage; destroyed sections can destabilize nearby construction at the DM's discretion. After 7 days, or if you cast the spell elsewhere, the fortress safely sinks away. Casting on the same spot every 7 days for one year makes it permanent.

name: Mind Blank
effectSummary: For 24 hours, one willing creature you touch is immune to psychic damage, charm, emotional sensing, thought reading, and divination spells. The protection also defeats wish and similarly powerful effects used to affect the target's mind or obtain information about it.

name: Mind Spike
effectSummary: One visible creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save, taking 3d8 psychic damage on a failure or half on a success. On a failed save, while you remain on the same plane you always know its location for up to 1 hour; it cannot hide from you, and invisibility gives it no benefit against you. Each slot level above 2nd adds 1d8 damage.

name: Mind Thrust (UA)
effectSummary: One visible creature within 60 feet makes an Intelligence save. On a failure it takes 3d6 psychic damage, cannot take reactions until the end of its next turn, and on that next turn may use only one of movement, an action, or a bonus action. On a success it takes half damage and suffers no other effect. Each slot level above 2nd adds one target, with all targets within 30 feet of one another.

On a success it takes half damage and suffers no other effect. Each slot level above 2nd adds one target, with all targets within 30 feet of one another.

name: Minor Illusion
effectSummary: Create either a sound or an image of an object within 30 feet for 1 minute; it ends early if dismissed or you cast the spell again. A sound may range from a whisper to a scream and may be continuous or intermittent. An image must fit within a 5-foot cube and cannot produce sound, light, smell, or other sensory effects; physical interaction reveals it as insubstantial. A creature can use an action for an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to identify the illusion, after which it becomes faint to that creature.

name: Mirage Arcane
effectSummary: For 10 days, reshape the sensory appearance and physical feel of terrain in an area up to 1 mile square, while preserving its general shape. You can make terrain seem and function as difficult or easy ground and alter or add structures, but cannot disguise, hide, or create creatures. The illusion includes visual, auditory, tactile, and olfactory effects; removed illusory terrain objects disappear outside the area. Truesight reveals the true terrain visually, but the creature remains physically able to interact with the illusion's other properties.

name: Mirror Image
effectSummary: Create three illusory duplicates of yourself for 1 minute. When a creature targets you with an attack, roll d20: with three duplicates, 6+ redirects it to a duplicate; with two, 8+; with one, 11+. A duplicate has AC 10 + your Dexterity modifier and is destroyed only by an attack that hits it; all other damage and effects are ignored. The spell ends when all duplicates are gone and can be dismissed as an action. Creatures that cannot see, rely on nonvisual senses such as blindsight, or can perceive illusions as false such as with truesight are unaffected.

name: Mislead
effectSummary: Become invisible for up to 1 hour while an illusory double appears where you stood. Your invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell, but the double remains for the spell's duration. As an action, move the double up to twice your speed and make it gesture, speak, and behave as you choose. You can see and hear through it, and as a bonus action switch between its senses and your own; while using the double's senses, you are blind and deaf to your actual surroundings.

name: Misty Step
effect: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.
description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

name: Modify Memory
effectSummary: One visible creature within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save, with advantage if you are fighting it. On a failure it is charmed, incapacitated, and unaware of its surroundings for up to 1 minute, though it can hear you; damage or another spell targeting it ends this spell without altering memory. While the charm lasts, verbally redefine one event from the last 24 hours that lasted no more than 10 minutes: erase it, make it perfectly clear, change details, or replace it with another event. The target must understand your language, and the modification takes hold only if you finish the description before the spell ends. Implausible memories may be dismissed and need not alter behavior. Remove curse or greater restoration restores the true memory. A 6th-level slot reaches 7 days back, 7th reaches 30 days, 8th reaches 1 year, and 9th can alter an event from any time in the target's past.

name: Mold Earth
effectSummary: Manipulate visible dirt or stone fitting in a 5-foot cube within 30 feet. Choose one: instantly excavate loose earth and move it along the ground up to 5 feet without damaging force; create words, images, shapes, or colors for 1 hour; or make ground difficult terrain or restore difficult ground to normal for 1 hour. You can have at most two noninstantaneous effects active at once and can dismiss one as an action.

name: Moonbeam
components: M (several seeds of any moonseed plant and a piece of opalescent feldspar)
effectSummary: Create a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder of dim light centered within 120 feet for up to 1 minute. A creature entering the area for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a Constitution save, taking 2d10 radiant damage on a failure or half on a success. Shapechangers make this save with disadvantage; on a failed save they also revert to their original form and cannot change shape while in the beam. As an action on later turns, move the beam up to 60 feet. Each slot level above 2nd adds 1d10 damage.

name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
components: M (a tiny silver whistle, a piece of bone, and a thread)
effectSummary: Conjure an invisible, invulnerable phantom watchdog in a visible unoccupied space within 30 feet for 8 hours, until dismissed, or until you move more than 100 feet away. A Small-or-larger creature entering within 30 feet without speaking your chosen password causes the hound to bark loudly. It sees invisible creatures, sees into the Ethereal Plane, and ignores illusions. At the start of each of your turns, it makes a melee attack against one hostile creature within 5 feet using your spellcasting ability modifier + proficiency bonus to hit; a hit deals 4d8 piercing damage.

name: Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion
components: M (a miniature portal carved from ivory, a small piece of polished marble, and a tiny silver spoon, each item worth at least 5 gp)
effectSummary: Create a 5-by-10-foot portal within 300 feet leading to a warm extradimensional mansion for 24 hours. You choose who may enter and can open or close the portal while within 30 feet; when closed it is invisible. The interior may use any floor plan totaling no more than fifty 10-foot cubes, is furnished as you choose, contains a nine-course banquet for up to 100 people, and has 100 obedient noncombatant servants that cannot leave. Conjured furnishings vanish if removed. When the spell ends, creatures and objects inside are expelled to the nearest open spaces by the entrance.

name: Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum
components: M (a thin sheet of lead, a piece of opaque glass, a wad of cotton or cloth, and powdered chrysolite)
effectSummary: Ward a cube from 5 to 100 feet on a side within 120 feet for 24 hours, choosing any combination of protections: sound cannot cross its boundary; vision and darkvision cannot see through the dark, foggy boundary; divination sensors cannot appear inside or cross in; creatures inside cannot be targeted by divination; teleportation into or out of the area is blocked; and planar travel within it is blocked. You may dismiss the ward as an action. Casting on the same spot daily for one year makes it permanent. Each slot level above 4th can increase the cube's maximum side length by 100 feet.

name: Mordenkainen's Sword
components: M (a miniature platinum sword with a grip and pommel of copper and zinc, worth 250 gp)
effectSummary: Create a hovering force sword within 60 feet for up to 1 minute. When it appears, make a melee spell attack against a target within 5 feet of the sword; on a hit it deals 3d10 force damage. As a bonus action on later turns, move the sword up to 20 feet to a visible point and repeat the attack against the same or a different target.

name: Motivational Speech
effectSummary: Choose up to five creatures within 60 feet that can hear you. For 1 hour each gains 5 temporary HP and advantage on Wisdom saves; after an affected creature is hit by an attack, it has advantage on its next attack roll. When a creature loses all temporary HP granted by this spell, the spell ends for it. Each slot level above 3rd adds 5 temporary HP.

When a creature loses all temporary HP granted by this spell, the spell ends for it. Each slot level above 3rd adds 5 temporary HP.

name: Move Earth
components: M (an iron blade and a small bag containing a mixture of soils – clay, loam, and sand)
effectSummary: Reshape an area of dirt, sand, or clay up to 40 feet on a side within 120 feet for up to 2 hours. You may raise or lower ground, dig or fill trenches, create or flatten walls, or form pillars, with the maximum change no greater than half the area's largest dimension; each change takes 10 minutes. After each 10 minutes of concentration you may choose a new area. The slow movement normally cannot trap or injure creatures. The spell cannot directly manipulate natural or constructed stone or plant growth, though rocks, structures, and plants move with the earth and unstable structures may collapse.

name: Nathair's Mischief
components: M (a piece of crust from an apple pie)
effectSummary: Fill a visible 20-foot cube within 60 feet with fey-draconic magic for up to 1 minute. Roll 1d4 when cast and at the start of each of your turns; before each later roll you may move the cube up to 10 feet. On 1, creatures in the cube make Wisdom saves or are charmed by you until the start of your next turn. On 2, they make Dexterity saves or are blinded until then. On 3, they make Wisdom saves or become incapacitated and spend all movement in a random direction until then. On 4, the cube becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.

name: Negative Energy Flood
components: M (a broken bone and a square of black silk)
effectSummary: Target one visible creature within 60 feet. A non-undead target makes a Constitution save, taking 5d12 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success; if killed by this damage, it rises as a zombie at the start of your next turn and pursues the nearest creature it can see. An undead target makes no save; instead roll 5d12 and it gains temporary HP equal to half the total.

name: Nondetection
components: M (a pinch of diamond dust worth 25 gp sprinkled over the target, which the spell consumes)
effect: For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from divination magic. The target can be a willing creature or a place or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. The target can’t be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

name: Otherworldly Form (UA)
components: M (an object engraved with a symbol of the Outer Planes, worth at least 500 gp)
sourceBook: Unearthed Arcana 70 - Spells and Magic Tattoos
effectSummary: Transform yourself for up to 1 minute using power from either the Lower or Upper Planes. Lower Planes grants immunity to fire and poison damage and the poisoned condition; Upper Planes grants immunity to radiant and necrotic damage and the charmed condition. Either choice also gives a 40-foot flying speed, +2 AC, makes your weapon attacks magical, lets you use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for weapon attack and damage rolls, and lets you attack twice when taking the Attack action unless another feature already gives you extra attacks.

name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
effectSummary: Launch a frigid globe to a point within 300 feet, where it explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere. Creatures there make Constitution saves, taking 10d6 cold damage on a failure or half on a success. If the globe hits primarily water, it freezes a 30-foot square to 6 inches deep for 1 minute; surface swimmers are trapped and can use an action for a Strength check against your spell save DC to break free. Instead of firing immediately, you may hold the sling-stone-sized globe; anyone can throw it 40 feet or launch it with a sling, causing the same explosion on impact. If not detonated within 1 minute, it explodes automatically. Each slot level above 6th adds 1d6 damage.

name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
effectSummary: One visible creature within 30 feet that is not immune to charm begins dancing for up to 1 minute. It must use all movement dancing in place, has disadvantage on Dexterity saves and attack rolls, and attacks against it have advantage. As an action, it can make a Wisdom save, ending the spell on a success.

name: Pass Without Trace
components: M (ashes from a burned leaf of mistletoe and a sprig of spruce)
effectSummary: For up to 1 hour, creatures you choose within 30 feet of you, including yourself, gain +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks, cannot be tracked except by magical means, and leave no tracks or other traces of passage.

name: Passwall
effectSummary: Create a passage through a visible wooden, plaster, or stone surface within 30 feet for 1 hour. The opening can be up to 5 feet wide, 8 feet tall, and 20 feet deep and does not destabilize the surrounding structure. When it closes, creatures and objects still inside are safely ejected to the nearest unoccupied space by the surface.

name: Phantasmal Killer
effectSummary: One visible creature within 120 feet makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it is frightened by an illusion of its deepest fear for up to 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the Wisdom save; on a failure it takes 4d10 psychic damage, and on a success the spell ends. Each slot level above 4th adds 1d10 damage.

name: Phantom Steed
effectSummary: Create a Large quasi-real horse with saddle, bit, and bridle in a visible unoccupied ground space within 30 feet for 1 hour. You choose its appearance and its rider. It uses riding-horse statistics except for 100-foot speed and travel of 10 miles per hour, or 13 miles at a fast pace. Conjured tack vanishes if carried more than 10 feet from the steed. Damage, your action to dismiss it, or duration ending causes it to fade over 1 minute, giving the rider time to dismount.

name: Planar Ally
effectSummary: Ask a known cosmic power for aid; it sends a loyal celestial, elemental, or fiend to a visible unoccupied space within 60 feet. You may request a named servant, but the DM chooses what arrives. The creature is not compelled to help; if you can communicate, negotiate payment for a service. Typical guidance is 100 gp per minute, 1,000 gp per hour, or 10,000 gp per day for up to 10 days, adjusted by the DM for ethos, danger, and circumstances; aligned or nonhazardous tasks may cost less, and suicidal tasks are rarely accepted. If no agreement is reached it returns home immediately; otherwise it serves as agreed, then returns after reporting if appropriate. A creature joining your group receives a full share of earned XP.

name: Planar Binding
components: M (a jewel worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
effectSummary: Keep a celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend within 60 feet throughout the 1-hour casting. At completion it makes a Charisma save; on a failure it is bound to serve you for 24 hours, and any spell that summoned or created it is extended to the same duration. The creature follows your instructions as well as possible, but a hostile creature interprets them literally and tries to twist them to its own aims. If it finishes early, it reports to you if you are on the same plane; otherwise it returns to the binding location until the spell ends. A 6th-level slot lasts 10 days, 7th lasts 30 days, 8th lasts 180 days, and 9th lasts 1 year and 1 day.
description: Keep a celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend within 60 feet throughout the 1-hour casting. name: Polymorph
effectSummary: Transform one visible creature with more than 0 HP into a beast for up to 1 hour. An unwilling creature makes a Wisdom save; a shapechanger automatically succeeds. The beast's CR cannot exceed the target's CR, or its level if it has no CR. Its statistics, including mental abilities, become the beast's, while alignment and personality remain. name: Prismatic Spray

name: Prismatic Wall
effectSummary: Create an opaque seven-layer wall up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick, or a sphere up to 30 feet in diameter, for 10 minutes; placing it through a creature causes the spell to fail. It sheds bright light 100 feet and dim light another 100. You and designated creatures are unharmed near or through it; other creatures that see it and come within 20 feet or start there make Constitution saves or are blinded for 1 minute. Crossing requires a Dexterity save against each remaining layer in order. Red deals 10d6 fire, blocks nonmagical ranged attacks, and is destroyed by 25 cold damage. Orange deals 10d6 acid, blocks magical ranged attacks, and is destroyed by strong wind. Yellow deals 10d6 lightning and is destroyed by 60 force damage. Green deals 10d6 poison and is destroyed by passwall or an equal-or-higher-level portal-opening spell. Blue deals 10d6 cold and is destroyed by 25 fire damage. Indigo restrains on a failed save; the creature makes Constitution saves at turn ends until three successes end it or three failures permanently petrify it, while the layer blocks spellcasting through the wall and is destroyed by daylight or similar equal-or-higher-level bright-light magic. Violet blinds on a failed save, followed at the start of your next turn by a Wisdom save; success ends blindness, failure sends the creature to a DM-chosen plane, and the layer is destroyed by dispel magic or similar equal-or-higher-level magic-ending effects. Antimagic field does not suppress the wall.

name: Regenerate
components: M (a prayer wheel and holy water)
effectSummary: Touch one creature. It immediately regains 4d8+15 HP and, for 1 hour, regains 1 HP at the start of each of its turns. Missing body parts regrow after 2 minutes; if a severed part is held to its stump, it reattaches instantly.

name: Reincarnate
components: M (rare oils and unguents worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
effectSummary: Touch a dead humanoid or a piece of one that died no more than 10 days ago. If its soul is free and willing, create a new adult body and return the creature to life in a new race chosen by the DM or rolled on the spell's table: dragonborn 01–04; hill dwarf 05–13; mountain dwarf 14–21; drow 22–25; high elf 26–34; wood elf 35–42; forest gnome 43–46; rock gnome 47–52; half-elf 53–56; half-orc 57–60; lightfoot halfling 61–68; stout halfling 69–76; human 77–96; tiefling 97–00. The creature remembers its former life and retains its prior capabilities except that its original race and racial traits are replaced by the new ones.

name: Remove Curse
effect: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner’s attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded.

name: Resistance
effect: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice. It can roll the die before or after the saving throw. The spell then ends.

name: Resurrection
components: M (a diamond worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
effectSummary: Return a touched non-undead creature dead no more than 100 years and not dead of old age to life with full HP if its soul is free and willing. Neutralize poisons, cure normal diseases, close mortal wounds, and restore missing body parts, but magical diseases, curses, and similar effects remain unless removed first. The revived creature has -4 to attacks, saves, and ability checks, reduced by 1 after each long rest. If the creature was dead for at least 1 year, after casting you cannot cast spells and have disadvantage on attacks, ability checks, and saves until you finish a long rest.

name: Reverse Gravity
effectSummary: Reverse gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered within 100 feet for up to 1 minute. Unanchored creatures and objects fall upward when cast; a creature can make a Dexterity save to grab a reachable fixed object and avoid the fall. Anything that hits a solid surface takes normal falling consequences; otherwise it reaches the top and remains there, gently oscillating, until the spell ends, when affected creatures and objects fall downward normally.

name: Revivify
components: M (diamonds worth 300 gp, which the spell consumes)
effect: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point. This spell can’t return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts.

name: Rime's Binding Ice
effectSummary: Creatures in a 30-foot cone make Constitution saves. On a failure, a creature takes 3d8 cold damage and is bound by ice for up to 1 minute, reducing its speed to 0 until it or another creature within reach uses an action to break the ice away. On a success it takes half damage and is not bound. Each slot level above 2nd adds 1d8 cold damage.

name: Rope Trick
components: M (powdered corn extract and a twisted loop of parchment)
effectSummary: Touch a rope up to 60 feet long; it rises vertically and opens an invisible extradimensional entrance at its top for 1 hour. Up to eight Medium-or-smaller creatures can enter by climbing, and the rope can be pulled inside and hidden. Attacks and spells cannot cross the entrance in either direction, while occupants can see out through a 3-by-5-foot window centered on the rope. Anything still inside falls out when the spell ends.

name: Sacred Flame
effectSummary: One visible creature within 60 feet makes a Dexterity save, gaining no benefit from cover; on a failure it takes 1d8 radiant damage. Damage becomes 2d8 at character level 5, 3d8 at 11, and 4d8 at 17.

name: Sanctuary
effectSummary: Ward one creature within 30 feet for 1 minute. A creature trying to target the warded creature with an attack or harmful spell must first make a Wisdom save; on a failure it must choose another target or lose that attack or spell. Area effects still affect the warded creature. The ward ends if the protected creature makes an attack, casts a spell affecting an enemy, or deals damage to another creature.

name: Sapping Sting
effectSummary: One visible creature within 30 feet makes a Constitution save or takes 1d4 necrotic damage and falls prone. Damage becomes 2d4 at character level 5, 3d4 at 11, and 4d4 at 17.

name: Scatter
effectSummary: Choose up to five visible creatures within 30 feet. An unwilling creature can make a Wisdom save to resist. Teleport each affected creature to a visible unoccupied space on the ground or floor within 120 feet of you.

name: Scorching Ray
effectSummary: Create three rays of fire and make a separate ranged spell attack with each against creatures within 120 feet, dividing them among targets as desired. Each hit deals 2d6 fire damage. Each slot level above 2nd creates one additional ray.

name: Scrying
components: M (a focus worth at least 1,000 gp, such as a crystal ball, a silver mirror, or a font filled with holy water)
effectSummary: Observe a chosen creature on your plane for up to 10 minutes. It makes a Wisdom save modified by familiarity—secondhand +5, firsthand +0, familiar -5—and physical connections—likeness -2, possession or garment -4, body part or similar -10. It may willingly fail if it knows you are casting. On a success, the spell fails and cannot target that creature again for 24 hours. On a failure, an invisible fist-sized sensor appears within 10 feet of it and moves with it; you see and hear through the sensor as if present. A creature that sees invisible objects can see the sensor. Instead of a creature, you may target a previously seen location; the sensor appears there and remains stationary.

name: See Invisibility
components: M (a pinch of talc and a small sprinkling of powdered silver)
effect: For the duration, you see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane. Ethereal creatures and objects appear ghostly and translucent.

name: Seeming
effectSummary: Give any number of visible creatures within 30 feet illusory appearances for 8 hours; an unwilling target can make a Charisma save to resist. The illusion alters apparent body, clothing, armor, weapons, and gear and can change apparent height by up to 1 foot, but cannot change basic body type or limb arrangement. Physical inspection can reveal discrepancies. A creature can use an action to inspect a target and make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC, recognizing the disguise on a success. You may dismiss the spell as an action.

name: Sending
components: M (a short piece of fine copper wire)
effectSummary: Send a message of up to 25 words to a familiar creature at any distance. It hears the message mentally, recognizes you if it knows you, understands the meaning if its Intelligence is at least 1, and may immediately reply in the same way. The spell can cross planes, but if the target is on another plane there is a 5% chance the message fails to arrive.

name: Sense Emotion (UA)
effectSummary: For up to 1 minute, when cast and as an action on later turns, focus on one visible humanoid within 30 feet and learn its prevailing emotion, such as love, anger, pain, fear, or calm. If the target is not actually a humanoid or is immune to charm, you instead sense it as calm.

name: Sequester
components: M (a powder composed of diamond, emerald, ruby, and sapphire dust worth at least 5,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
effectSummary: Touch a willing creature or object to hide it until dispelled or a condition you set occurs. The target becomes invisible, cannot be targeted by divination spells or perceived through divination-created scrying sensors, and a creature target enters suspended animation without aging. The release condition can be anything that occurs or is visible within 1 mile of the target. The spell also ends if the target takes damage.

name: Shadow Blade
effectSummary: Create a magic shadow sword in your hand for up to 1 minute. You are proficient with it; it is a simple melee weapon with finesse, light, and thrown 20/60, deals 2d8 psychic damage, and attacks with it have advantage against targets in dim light or darkness. If dropped or thrown it dissipates at the end of the turn, and you can recreate it as a bonus action while the spell lasts. A 3rd- or 4th-level slot raises damage to 3d8, 5th or 6th to 4d8, and 7th or higher to 5d8.

effectSummary: For up to 1 minute, flame-like shadows heavily obscure you to others, turn dim light within 10 feet of you into darkness and bright light there into dim light, and give you resistance to radiant damage. Whenever a creature within 10 feet hits you with an attack, it takes 2d8 necrotic damage.

name: Shape Water
effectSummary: Manipulate visible water fitting in a 5-foot cube within 30 feet. Choose one: instantly move or redirect its flow up to 5 feet without damaging force; form and animate simple shapes for 1 hour; change its color or opacity uniformly for 1 hour; or freeze it for 1 hour if no creature is in it. You may have no more than two noninstantaneous effects from this spell active at once and can dismiss one as an action.

name: Shapechange
components: M (a jade circlet worth at least 1,500 gp, which you must place on your head before you cast the spell)
effectSummary: For up to 1 hour, assume the form of a creature you have seen whose CR is no greater than your level, excluding constructs, undead, creatures with class levels, and forms with the Spellcasting trait. Your statistics become the form's except you retain alignment; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma; your skill and save proficiencies plus any better matching bonuses from the form; and usable class, race, and other features your new body can physically support. You cannot use the form's legendary or lair actions, and retain special senses only if the form also has them. You gain the form's HP and Hit Dice, returning to your previous HP when reverting; excess damage from a 0-HP reversion carries over. You can speak only if the form normally can. Choose whether equipment falls, merges, or is worn; merged gear has no effect and impractical gear falls. As an action during the spell, change to another legal form; if that form's maximum HP exceeds your current HP, your current HP does not increase.

name: Shatter
effectSummary: Creatures in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered within 60 feet make Constitution saves, taking 3d8 thunder damage on a failure or half on a success; creatures made of inorganic material such as stone, crystal, or metal have disadvantage. Nonmagical unattended objects in the area also take the damage. Each slot level above 2nd adds 1d8 damage.

effect: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from magic missile .

components: M (a small parchment with a bit of holy text written on it)
effect: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

name: Shillelagh
components: M (mistletoe, a shamrock leaf, and a club or quarterstaff)
effectSummary: For 1 minute, a club or quarterstaff you hold becomes magical; its melee damage die becomes d8 and you may use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for its melee attack and damage rolls. The spell ends if you cast it again or let go of the weapon.

name: Shocking Grasp
effectSummary: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can touch, with advantage if it wears metal armor. On a hit it takes 1d8 lightning damage and cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn. Damage becomes 2d8 at character level 5, 3d8 at 11, and 4d8 at 17.

name: Sickening Radiance
effectSummary: Dim green light fills a 30-foot-radius sphere centered within 120 feet, spreading around corners for up to 10 minutes. A creature entering the area for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a Constitution save; on a failure it takes 4d10 radiant damage, gains one level of exhaustion, and emits dim green light in a 5-foot radius that prevents it from benefiting from invisibility. Exhaustion and light caused by this spell end when the spell ends.

name: Silence
effectSummary: For up to 10 minutes, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered within 120 feet. Creatures and objects entirely inside are immune to thunder damage, creatures entirely inside are deafened, and spells with verbal components cannot be cast there.

name: Silent Image
effectSummary: Create a purely visual illusion no larger than a 15-foot cube at a point within 60 feet for up to 10 minutes. As an action, move it anywhere within range and alter its appearance so the motion looks natural. Physical interaction reveals it as insubstantial. A creature can use an action for an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to recognize the illusion; on a success it can see through it.

name: Silvery Barbs
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself succeeds on an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw
effectSummary: As a reaction when a visible creature within 60 feet succeeds on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, force it to reroll the d20 and use the lower result. Then choose a different visible creature in range, possibly yourself; it gains advantage on its next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw made within 1 minute. A creature can benefit from only one use of this spell at a time.

name: Simulacrum
components: M (snow or ice in quantities sufficient to make a life-size copy of the duplicated creature; some hair, fingernail clippings, or other piece of that creature’s body placed inside the snow or ice; and powdered ruby worth 1,500 gp, sprinkled over the duplicate and consumed by the spell)
effectSummary: Over 12 hours, create an ice-and-snow duplicate of one beast or humanoid that remains within touch range throughout the casting. The simulacrum is a construct that otherwise uses the original's statistics, appears identical, has half the original's hit point maximum, and starts with no equipment. It is friendly to you and designated creatures, obeys spoken commands, and acts on your turn. It cannot learn, gain levels or other abilities, or recover expended spell slots. Damage can be repaired in an alchemical laboratory for 100 gp of rare materials per HP restored. At 0 HP it melts into snow. Casting simulacrum again destroys any active duplicate you previously created with this spell.

effectSummary: Touch a willing creature and choose a skill in which it is proficient and is not already benefiting from an effect that doubles proficiency. For up to 1 hour, it doubles its proficiency bonus on ability checks using that skill.

name: Skywrite
effect: You cause up to ten words to form in a part of the sky you can see. The words appear to be made of cloud and remain in place for the spell’s duration. The words dissipate when the spell ends. A strong wind can disperse the clouds and end the spell early.

name: Sleep
components: M (a pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket)
effectSummary: Roll 5d8 for a hit-point pool. Starting with the conscious creature with the lowest current HP within 20 feet of a point in range, a creature falls unconscious for 1 minute if its current HP is no greater than the remaining pool; subtract its HP and continue upward. The sleep ends for a creature if it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake or slap it awake. Undead and creatures immune to charm are unaffected. name: Slow
effectSummary: Up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube within 120 feet make Wisdom saves. On a failure, for up to 1 minute a target's speed is halved, it has -2 AC and Dexterity saves, cannot take reactions, may use either an action or bonus action on its turn but not both, and cannot make more than one weapon attack on its turn. If it casts a 1-action spell, roll d20; on 11+ the spell is delayed until its next turn, when it must spend its action completing it or the spell is wasted. An affected creature repeats the Wisdom save at the end of each turn, ending the effect on itself on a success.

effectSummary: Consume 25 feet of rope to make a nearly invisible 5-foot-radius ground trap lasting 8 hours; discerning it requires an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. name: Soul Cage
casting_time: 1 reaction, which you take when a humanoid you can see within 60 feet of you dies
components: M (a tiny silver cage worth 100 gp)
effectSummary: As a reaction when a visible humanoid within 60 feet dies, trap its soul in the spell's silver cage for up to 8 hours. While trapped, the corpse cannot be revived. You may exploit the soul up to six times; after the sixth use it is released and the spell ends. Steal Life: bonus action to regain 2d8 HP. Query Soul: ask a question without an action and receive a truthful brief telepathic answer based only on what it knew in life. Borrow Experience: bonus action to gain advantage on your next attack roll, ability check, or save before your next turn. Eyes of the Dead: action to create an invisible sensor at a place the humanoid saw in life on your current plane, seeing and hearing through it while concentrating up to 10 minutes; creatures that can see invisible things perceive a translucent image of the trapped soul.

name: Speak with Dead
effectSummary: Animate the semblance of life in a corpse within 10 feet that still has a mouth and is not undead. The spell fails if that corpse was targeted by this spell within the last 10 days. For 10 minutes, you may ask up to five questions; it knows only what it knew in life, including its languages, and answers are usually brief, cryptic, or repetitive. It is not compelled to be truthful if hostile to you or if it recognizes you as an enemy. The creature's soul does not return, so it cannot learn new information or speculate about later or future events.

name: Spirit Of Death
components: M (a gilded playing card worth at least 400 gp and depicting an avatar of death)
effectSummary: Summon a Medium undead Reaper Spirit in a visible unoccupied space within 60 feet for up to 1 hour. It is your ally, shares your initiative and acts immediately after you, obeys verbal commands without requiring your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. AC is 11 + spell level; HP 40 + 10 per spell level above 4th; speed 30 ft., fly 30 ft. hover; all ability scores 16 (+3); immune to necrotic and poison damage and to charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, and poisoned; darkvision 60 ft.; understands your languages. It can move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain, taking 1d10 force per 5 feet if it ends inside an object and is shunted out. Multiattack makes a number of Reaping Scythe attacks equal to half the spell level rounded down; each uses your spell attack modifier with advantage and deals 1d8 + 3 + spell level necrotic. Haunting lasts until the target dies, the spirit disappears, or it haunts another target. Higher-level slots scale all spell-level statistics.

effectSummary: Summon a Large Celestial Spirit in a visible unoccupied space within 90 feet for up to 1 hour, choosing Avenger or Defender. It is your ally, shares your initiative and acts immediately after you, obeys verbal commands without your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. AC is 11 + spell level, plus 2 for Defender; HP 40 + 10 per spell level above 5th; speed 30 ft., fly 40 ft.; Str 16, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 16; radiant resistance; immune to charmed and frightened; darkvision 60 ft.; speaks Celestial and understands your languages. It makes a number of attacks equal to half the spell level rounded down. Avenger's Radiant Bow is a 150/600 ranged attack for 2d6 + 2 + spell level radiant; Defender's Radiant Mace is a melee attack for 1d10 + 3 + spell level radiant and grants 1d10 temporary HP to itself or a creature within 10 feet of the target. Once per day Healing Touch restores 2d8 + spell level HP to another creature. Higher-level slots scale spell-level statistics.

name: Summon Draconic Spirit

effectSummary: Summon a Large neutral Draconic Spirit in a visible unoccupied space within 60 feet for up to 1 hour, choosing Chromatic, Gem, or Metallic. name: Summon Fey
components: M (a gilded flower worth at least 300 gp)
effectSummary: Summon a Small Fey Spirit in a visible unoccupied space within 90 feet for up to 1 hour, choosing Fuming, Mirthful, or Tricksy. It is your ally, shares your initiative and acts immediately after you, obeys verbal commands without your action, and otherwise Dodges and avoids danger. AC is 12 + spell level; HP 30 + 10 per spell level above 3rd; speed 40 ft.; Str 13, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 14, Wis 11, Cha 16; immune to charmed; darkvision 60 ft.; speaks Sylvan and understands your languages. Higher-level slots scale spell-level statistics.

name: Summon Greater Demon
components: M (a vial of blood from a humanoid killed within the past 24 hours)
effectSummary: Summon one demon of a chosen type with CR 5 or lower into a visible unoccupied space within 60 feet for up to 1 hour. It has its own initiative. When summoned and on each of your turns, you may issue a verbal command without using an action; without a command it attacks any creature within reach that attacked it. At the end of each of its turns it makes a Charisma save, with disadvantage if you speak its true name; on success you permanently lose control for the rest of the spell and it attacks the nearest non-demons. If concentration ends early after control is lost, it remains for 1d6 rounds if still alive. You may consume the blood component to draw a protective circle around your space that the demon cannot cross, harm, or target into while the spell lasts. Each slot level above 4th raises the maximum CR by 1.

name: Summon Lesser Demons
components: M (a vial of blood from a humanoid killed within the past 24 hours)
effectSummary: Summon hostile demons into visible unoccupied spaces within 60 feet for up to 1 hour; roll 1d6 to determine the group: 1–2 summons two demons of CR 1 or lower, 3–4 summons four of CR 1/2 or lower, and 5–6 summons eight of CR 1/4 or lower. The DM chooses the demon types. They share an initiative group and attack the nearest non-demons, including you and your allies. You may consume the blood component to draw a protective circle around your space that the demons cannot cross, harm, or target into while the spell lasts. A 6th- or 7th-level slot doubles the number summoned; an 8th- or 9th-level slot triples it.

name: Sunbeam
effectSummary: Fire a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot line of sunlight when cast and, as an action on later turns while concentrating up to 1 minute, again. Creatures in the line make Constitution saves, taking 6d8 radiant damage and becoming blinded until your next turn on a failure, or half damage without blindness on a success; undead and oozes have disadvantage on the save. For the duration, your hand also sheds bright sunlight for 30 feet and dim light for another 30 feet.

name: Swift Quiver
components: M (a quiver containing at least one piece of ammunition)
effectSummary: For up to 1 minute, a touched quiver containing ammunition produces an endless supply of matching nonmagical ammunition. name: Symbol
components: M (mercury, phosphorus, and powdered diamond and opal with a total value of at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
effectSummary: Inscribe a nearly invisible glyph on a surface up to 10 feet across or inside a closable object; an object glyph breaks if moved more than 10 feet from the casting location. Define a trigger based on interaction, proximity, observation, physical traits or creature kind, and optional exemptions such as a password. When triggered, the glyph glows with dim light in a 60-foot-radius sphere for 10 minutes and affects creatures in the sphere when activated and creatures that enter for the first time on a turn or end a turn there. Choose one effect: Death—Constitution save, 10d10 necrotic, half on success; Discord—Constitution save or for 1 minute unable to communicate meaningfully and disadvantaged on attacks and ability checks; Fear—Wisdom save or frightened 1 minute, drop held items, and move at least 20 feet away each turn if able; Hopelessness—Charisma save or for 1 minute cannot attack or target creatures with harmful abilities, spells, or magic; Insanity—Intelligence save or for 1 minute cannot take actions, understand speech, read, or speak coherently, with erratic DM-controlled movement; Pain—Constitution save or incapacitated for 1 minute; Sleep—Wisdom save or unconscious for 10 minutes, ending on damage or an action to wake; Stunning—Wisdom save or stunned for 1 minute.

effectSummary: Creatures in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line make Dexterity saves. On a failure they are covered in acid for up to 1 minute and take 2d4 acid damage at the start of each of their turns until they or another creature uses an action to scrape or wash the acid away. Each slot level above 1st adds 2d4 damage.

name: Tasha's Mind Whip
effectSummary: One visible creature within 90 feet makes an Intelligence save. On a failure it takes 3d6 psychic damage, cannot take reactions until the end of its next turn, and on that next turn may use only one of movement, an action, or a bonus action. On a success it takes half damage with no other effect. Each slot level above 2nd adds one target, with all targets within 30 feet of one another.

name: Tasha's Otherworldly Guise
components: M (an object engraved with a symbol of the Outer Planes, worth at least 500 gp)
effectSummary: For up to 1 minute, transform using Lower or Upper Planes power. Lower Planes grants immunity to fire and poison damage and the poisoned condition; Upper Planes grants immunity to radiant and necrotic damage and the charmed condition. Either form gives a 40-foot flying speed, +2 AC, makes weapon attacks magical, lets you use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength or Dexterity for weapon attack and damage rolls, and lets you attack twice when taking the Attack action unless another feature already grants multiple attacks.

name: Telekinesis
effectSummary: When cast and as your action each round for up to 10 minutes, manipulate one visible creature or object within 60 feet. Creature: target a Huge-or-smaller creature and contest your spellcasting-ability check against its Strength check; on a win, move it up to 30 feet in any direction within range and restrain it until the end of your next turn, with later actions repeating the contest to maintain the grip. Object: move an unattended object up to 1,000 pounds automatically up to 30 feet, or contest a carrier's Strength check to pull away and move a worn or carried object. You can also use fine control for simple manipulation such as tools, doors, containers, or pouring a vial. Switching targets ends the previous effect.

name: Telepathy
components: M (a pair of linked silver rings)
effectSummary: For 24 hours, form an unlimited-range telepathic link with one willing familiar creature on the same plane. You can instantly exchange words, images, sounds, and other sensory messages, and a target with Intelligence 1 or higher understands the meaning of your words and sensory messages. The spell ends if either of you leaves the plane.

name: Teleport
effectSummary: Instantly transport yourself and up to eight willing visible creatures within 10 feet, or one visible object fitting in a 10-foot cube and not held by an unwilling creature, to a known destination on the same plane. A permanent teleportation circle whose sigil you know or an object taken from the destination within six months arrives on target automatically. Otherwise the DM rolls d100 based on familiarity: Very familiar—mishap 01–05, similar area 06–13, off target 14–24, on target 25–100; Seen casually—01–33, 34–43, 44–53, 54–100; Viewed once or Description—01–43, 44–53, 54–73, 74–100; False destination—mishap 01–50, similar area 51–100. Off target moves the group a random direction by 1d10×1d10 percent of the intended distance. Similar area sends it to a thematically or visually similar location. Mishap deals 3d10 force damage to each transported creature or the object, then rerolls and can repeat.

name: Teleportation Circle
components: M (rare chalks and inks infused with precious gems worth 50 gp, which the spell consumes)
effectSummary: Over 1 minute, draw a 10-foot-diameter portal circle linked to a permanent teleportation circle on the same plane whose sigil sequence you know. The portal remains until the end of your next turn; creatures entering appear within 5 feet of the destination circle or the nearest open space. When you first gain the spell you learn two Material Plane circle sequences and may learn others by studying them for 1 minute. Casting in the same place every day for one year creates a permanent teleportation circle.

name: Temple of the Gods
components: M (a holy symbol worth at least 5 gp)
effectSummary: After 1 hour, create a temple fitting within an unoccupied cube up to 120 feet per side for 24 hours, dedicated to the faith represented by the holy symbol used. You choose its appearance, windows, lighting, and designated creatures who can operate its single door. Choose one or more of celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead as opposed types; an opposed creature attempting entry makes a Charisma save or cannot enter for 24 hours, and even if inside subtracts 1d4 from attack rolls, ability checks, and saves. Divination sensors cannot appear inside and occupants cannot be targeted by divination. Healing from a spell of 1st level or higher restores extra HP equal to your Wisdom modifier, minimum 1. Its opaque magical-force exterior extends into the Ethereal Plane, blocks physical and ethereal entry, ignores dispel magic and antimagic field, but disintegrate destroys it. Casting on the same spot daily for one year makes it permanent.

name: Temporal Shunt
casting_time: 1 reaction, taken when a creature you see makes an attack roll or starts to cast a spell
effectSummary: As a reaction when a visible creature within 120 feet makes an attack roll or starts casting a spell, force it to make a Wisdom save. On a failure it vanishes until the start of its next turn, causing the attack to miss or the spell to be wasted; it then reappears in its former space or the nearest unoccupied space and does not remember being affected. Each slot level above 5th adds one target, with all targets within 30 feet of one another.

name: Tenser's Floating Disk
effectSummary: Create a 3-foot-diameter horizontal force disk that floats 3 feet above the ground in a visible unoccupied space within 30 feet for 1 hour. It carries up to 500 pounds; exceeding that ends the spell and drops its load. While you are within 20 feet it stays still; beyond 20 feet it follows to remain within 20 feet, navigating normal uneven terrain, stairs, and slopes but not elevation changes of 10 feet or more. The spell ends if you move more than 100 feet from it.

name: Tenser's Transformation
components: M (a few hairs from a bull)
effectSummary: For up to 10 minutes, you cannot cast spells but gain 50 temporary HP; advantage on attacks with simple and martial weapons; +2d12 force damage on weapon hits; proficiency with all armor, shields, simple weapons, martial weapons, and Strength and Constitution saves; and two attacks instead of one when you take the Attack action unless you already have a feature granting extra attacks. When the spell ends, make a DC 15 Constitution save or gain one level of exhaustion.

name: Tether Essence
components: M (a spool of platinum cord worth at least 250 gp, which the spell consumes)
effectSummary: Choose two visible creatures within 60 feet. Each makes a Constitution save, with disadvantage if they are within 30 feet of one another; either may fail willingly. If either succeeds, the spell has no effect. If both fail, they remain linked for up to 1 hour regardless of distance: damage dealt to one is also dealt to the other, and HP restored to one is restored equally to the other. If either reaches 0 HP or the spell ends for one, it ends for both.

name: Thaumaturgy
effectSummary: Create one minor supernatural effect within 30 feet: make your voice up to three times louder for 1 minute; alter flames for 1 minute; cause harmless ground tremors for 1 minute; create an instantaneous sound from a point in range; instantly open or slam shut an unlocked door or window; or alter your eyes for 1 minute. You may have up to three 1-minute effects active at once and can dismiss one as an action.

You may have up to three 1-minute effects active at once and can dismiss one as an action.

name: Thorn Whip
components: M (the stem of a plant with thorns)
effectSummary: Make a melee spell attack against one creature within 30 feet. On a hit it takes 1d6 piercing damage, and if Large or smaller you may pull it up to 10 feet toward you. Damage becomes 2d6 at character level 5, 3d6 at 11, and 4d6 at 17.

name: Thought Shield (UA)
sourceBook: Unearthed Arcana 66 - Fighter, Rogue, and Wizard
effectSummary: Touch one creature. For 8 hours, its mind cannot be read or detected, telepathic communication with it fails unless it allows the contact, and it has advantage on saves against effects that determine whether it is telling the truth.

name: Thunder Step
effectSummary: Teleport to a visible unoccupied space within 90 feet. Creatures within 10 feet of the space you left make Constitution saves, taking 3d10 thunder damage on a failure or half on a success; the boom is audible 300 feet away. You may bring carried objects within your capacity and one willing creature of your size or smaller within 5 feet, provided an open space exists within 5 feet of your destination. Each slot level above 3rd adds 1d10 damage.

name: Thunderclap
effectSummary: Each creature other than you within 5 feet makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 thunder damage; the sound is audible 100 feet away. Damage becomes 2d6 at character level 5, 3d6 at 11, and 4d6 at 17.

effectSummary: Creatures in a 15-foot cube originating from you make Constitution saves, taking 2d8 thunder damage and being pushed 10 feet away on a failure, or half damage without the push on a success. Unsecured objects entirely in the area are automatically pushed 10 feet away. The boom is audible 300 feet away. Each slot level above 1st adds 1d8 damage.

name: Tidal Wave
effectSummary: Conjure a wave occupying an area up to 30 feet long, 10 feet wide, and 10 feet tall within 120 feet. Creatures there make Dexterity saves, taking 4d8 bludgeoning damage and falling prone on a failure, or half damage without falling prone on a success. The water then spreads across the ground and extinguishes unprotected flames in the area and within 30 feet of it.

name: Time Ravage
components: M (an hourglass filled with diamond dust worth at least 5,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
effectSummary: One visible creature within 90 feet makes a Constitution save, taking 10d12 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. On a failed save it also rapidly ages until it has only 30 days left before dying of old age; while aged it has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws, and its walking speed is halved. Only wish or greater restoration cast with a 9th-level slot can end the aging effects and restore its prior age.

name: Time Stop
effectSummary: Stop time for everyone but yourself and take 1d4+1 turns in succession. The spell ends early if an action you take or an effect you create during those turns affects another creature or an object worn or carried by another creature, or if you move more than 1,000 feet from where you cast the spell.

name: Tiny Servant
effectSummary: Animate one Tiny nonmagical unattached, unattended object for 8 hours as a Tiny Construct under your control. As a bonus action while it is within 120 feet, mentally command it; multiple servants can receive the same command together. Without commands it only defends itself, and a command persists until complete. At 0 HP it reverts to the original object and excess damage carries over. Tiny Servant has AC 15, 10 HP, speed 30 ft. and climb 30 ft.; Str 4, Dex 16, Con 10, Int 2, Wis 10, Cha 1; immunity to poison and psychic damage and to blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned; blindsight 60 ft. and blindness beyond it; and a Slam at +5 to hit for 1d4+3 bludgeoning. Each slot level above 3rd animates two additional objects.

name: Toll the Dead
effectSummary: One visible creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it takes 1d8 necrotic damage, or 1d12 if it is missing any HP. The damage becomes 2 dice at character level 5, 3 dice at 11, and 4 dice at 17.

name: Tongues
components: M (a small clay model of a ziggurat)
effect: This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken language it hears. Moreover, when the target speaks, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear the target understands what it says.

name: Transmute Rock
effectSummary: Choose a visible area of stone or mud fitting within a 40-foot cube and transform it until dispelled. Rock to Mud: nonmagical rock becomes deep flowing mud; each foot of movement costs 4 feet, and creatures on the ground when cast, first entering on a turn, or ending a turn there make Strength saves or become restrained until using an action to pull free. If cast on a ceiling, the mud falls; creatures beneath make Dexterity saves for 4d8 bludgeoning damage, half on success. Mud to Rock: nonmagical mud or quicksand up to 10 feet deep becomes soft stone; creatures in it make Dexterity saves, becoming restrained on a failure or being shunted safely to the surface on a success. A restrained creature can use an action to escape with a DC 20 Strength check or by dealing 25 damage to the surrounding rock.

name: Transport via Plants
effectSummary: For 1 round, link a Large-or-larger inanimate plant within 10 feet to another plant on the same plane that you have previously seen or touched. Any creature can spend 5 feet of movement to step into the first plant and emerge from the destination plant.
description: For 1 round, link a Large-or-larger inanimate plant within 10 feet to another plant on the same plane that you have previously seen or touched. Any creature can spend 5 feet of movement to step into the first plant and emerge from the destination plant.

name: Tree Stride
effectSummary: For up to 1 minute, spend 5 feet of movement to enter a living tree at least your size and instantly learn the location of all same-kind trees within 500 feet. As part of that movement, either step out of the same tree or emerge from one of those trees, spending another 5 feet of movement and appearing within 5 feet of it. If no movement remains, you appear within 5 feet of the tree you entered. You can use this transportation once per round and must end each turn outside a tree.
