name: True Polymorph
components: M (a drop of mercury, a dollop of gum arabic, and a wisp of smoke)
effectSummary: Transform one visible creature with more than 0 HP or one unattended nonmagical object within 30 feet into another creature, a nonmagical object, or a creature respectively. Shapechangers are unaffected; an unwilling creature can make a Wisdom save. Creature to Creature: the new form's CR cannot exceed the target's CR or level; its game statistics, including mental abilities, become the new form's while alignment and personality remain. It uses the form's HP, reverts on 0 HP with excess damage carrying over, is limited by the form's capabilities, and its gear melds and cannot be used. Object to Creature: choose a creature no larger than the object and CR 9 or lower; it is friendly and follows your directions while the spell remains temporary, but if made permanent you no longer control it. Creature to Object: the target and its gear become an object no larger than its original size and it has no memory of time spent transformed. The transformation lasts up to 1 hour and becomes permanent if you maintain concentration for the full duration.

name: True Resurrection
components: M (a sprinkle of holy water and diamonds worth at least 25,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
effectSummary: After a 1-hour casting, touch a creature dead no more than 200 years that did not die of old age. If its soul is free and willing, return it to life with full HP, close all wounds, neutralize poison, cure all diseases, remove curses present at death, replace missing or damaged organs and limbs, and restore an undead creature to its non-undead form. If no body remains, the spell creates a new one and the creature appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet.

name: True Seeing
components: M (an ointment for the eyes that costs 25 gp; is made from mushroom powder, saffron, and fat; and is consumed by the spell)
effect: This spell gives the willing creature you touch the ability to see things as they actually are. For the duration, the creature has truesight, notices secret doors hidden by magic, and can see into the Ethereal Plane, all out to a range of 120 feet.

name: True Strike
effect: You extend your hand and point a finger at a target in range. Your magic grants you a brief insight into the target’s defenses. On your next turn, you gain advantage on your first attack roll against the target, provided that this spell hasn’t ended.
description: You extend your hand and point a finger at a target in range. Your magic grants you a brief insight into the target’s defenses. On your next turn, you gain advantage on your first attack roll against the target, provided that this spell hasn’t ended.

name: Tsunami
effectSummary: Create a wall of water at a visible point, up to 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 50 feet thick, for up to 6 rounds. When it appears, creatures in it make Strength saves, taking 6d10 bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success. At the start of each of your later turns, the wall and creatures in it move 50 feet away from you; Huge-or-smaller creatures inside or entered by the moving wall make Strength saves or take 5d10 bludgeoning damage, at most once per round. After each such turn the wall loses 50 feet of height and its later damage drops by 1d10; at 0 height the spell ends. A creature caught in the wall must succeed on a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC to swim at all, and falls to the ground upon leaving the area.

effectSummary: For up to 10 minutes, music fills a 30-foot radius around you, moves with you, spreads around corners, and can be heard 100 feet away. You have advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks. As a bonus action each turn, choose one creature within 30 feet that can see you and hear the music; it makes a Charisma save, automatically succeeding if you or your companions are attacking it. On a failure it becomes friendly to you while it can hear the music and for 1 hour afterward, and you have advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks against it.

If a commanded task would move it more than 60 feet from you, or it reaches 0 HP, the spell ends.

effectSummary: Make a melee spell attack against a creature in reach; on a hit it takes 3d6 necrotic damage and you regain HP equal to half the necrotic damage dealt. For up to 1 minute, you can repeat this attack as your action on each turn. Each slot level above 3rd adds 1d6 damage.

name: Vicious Mockery
effectSummary: One visible creature within 60 feet that can hear you makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it takes 1d4 psychic damage and has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. Damage becomes 2d4 at character level 5, 3d4 at 11, and 4d4 at 17.

name: Virtue (UA)
effect: You touch one creature, imbuing it with vitality. If the target has at least 1 hit point, it gains a number of temporary hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. The temporary hit points are lost when the spell ends.

Each slot level above 4th adds 2d4 to the initial damage.

The other side deals no damage. Each slot level above 4th adds 1d8 damage.

effectSummary: Create an invisible 1/4-inch-thick force barrier within 120 feet for up to 10 minutes as a hemisphere or sphere up to 10-foot radius, or as ten contiguous 10-foot-square panels in any orientation. A creature whose space is cut by the wall is pushed to a side you choose. Nothing physical can pass through; the wall is immune to damage, cannot be dispelled by dispel magic, extends into the Ethereal Plane to block ethereal travel, and is destroyed instantly by disintegrate.

Destroying a section leaves frigid air; a creature moving through that space for the first time on a turn makes a Constitution save for 5d6 cold damage, half on success. Each slot level above 6th adds 2d6 to the initial damage and 1d6 to the frigid-air damage.

name: Wall of Light
effectSummary: Create a bright wall within 120 feet for up to 10 minutes, up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick, in any orientation. It blocks line of sight but not movement and sheds bright light 120 feet plus dim light another 120. When it appears, creatures in it make Constitution saves, taking 4d8 radiant damage and becoming blinded for 1 minute on a failure, or half damage without blindness on a success; a blinded creature repeats the save at each turn end. A creature ending its turn in the wall takes 4d8 radiant damage. As an action, fire a beam at one visible creature within 60 feet of the wall; make a ranged spell attack for 4d8 radiant damage, then reduce the wall's length by 10 feet whether the attack hits or misses. At 0 length the spell ends. Each slot level above 5th adds 1d8 to all damage.

name: Wall of Stone
effectSummary: Create a nonmagical stone wall within 120 feet for up to 10 minutes from ten contiguous 10-by-10-foot panels 6 inches thick, or ten 10-by-20-foot panels 3 inches thick. A creature whose space is cut is pushed to one side; if enclosed by the wall and other solid surfaces, it can make a Dexterity save and on success use its reaction to move up to its speed out of the enclosure. The wall can be shaped, bridged, ramped, and crudely ornamented but must merge with and be supported by existing stone; spans over 20 feet require halved panel sizes for supports. Each panel has AC 15 and 30 HP per inch of thickness, and destroying one may collapse connected panels. Maintaining concentration for the full duration makes the wall permanent and no longer dispellable.

The spell ends if you reach 0 HP, you become more than 60 feet apart, the spell is cast again on either connected creature, or you dismiss it as an action.

effectSummary: A 20-mph wind blows in a 10-foot radius around you and moves with you for up to 10 minutes. It deafens creatures in the area, extinguishes unprotected torch-sized or smaller flames, makes the area difficult terrain for creatures other than you, imposes disadvantage on ranged weapon attacks passing into or out of it, and disperses vapor, gas, and fog that strong wind can disperse.

name: Warp Sense
effectSummary: For up to 1 minute, sense portals, including inactive ones, within 30 feet. After detecting one, you can use your action to make a DC 15 spellcasting-ability check to study it; on success you learn its destination plane and required portal key and the spell ends, while on failure you learn nothing and cannot study that portal again with the same casting. Detection penetrates most barriers but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

name: Watery Sphere
effectSummary: Create a 5-foot-radius water sphere at a visible point within 90 feet, hovering no more than 10 feet above the ground for up to 1 minute. A creature in its space makes a Strength save; Huge or larger succeeds automatically. On success it is ejected to the nearest open space; on failure it is restrained and engulfed, repeating the save at the end of each turn. The sphere can hold at most four Medium-or-smaller creatures or one Large creature, ejecting a random previously restrained creature if over capacity. As an action, move it up to 30 feet in a straight line; it descends safely over drops, carries restrained creatures, and can ram creatures to force the save at most once per turn. When the spell ends, the sphere falls, extinguishes normal flames within 30 feet, and knocks restrained creatures prone where it lands.

name: Web
effectSummary: Fill a 20-foot cube within 60 feet with sticky webs for up to 1 hour. The area is lightly obscured and difficult terrain. If the webs are not anchored between solid masses or laid across a floor, wall, or ceiling, they collapse and the spell ends at the start of your next turn; webs on a flat surface are 5 feet deep. A creature entering the webs or starting its turn there makes a Dexterity save or is restrained while it remains in the webs, and can use an action for a Strength check against your spell save DC to escape. Fire burns away each exposed 5-foot cube in 1 round and deals 2d4 fire damage to creatures starting their turn in that fire.

On a failure, a creature is frightened by illusory manifestations of its deepest fears for up to 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns while frightened, it makes another Wisdom save; on a failure it takes 4d10 psychic damage, and on a success the spell ends for it.

name: Whirlwind
effectSummary: Create a 10-foot-radius, 30-foot-high whirlwind centered on a ground point within 300 feet for up to 1 minute. As an action, move it up to 30 feet along the ground; it sucks up unsecured Medium-or-smaller objects. A creature first entering the whirlwind on a turn, or entered by the whirlwind, makes a Dexterity save for 10d6 bludgeoning damage, half on success. A Large-or-smaller creature that fails also makes a Strength save or is restrained inside. A restrained creature rises 5 feet at the start of each turn, moves with the whirlwind, and falls when the spell ends unless it can remain aloft. As an action it can make a Strength or Dexterity check against your spell save DC to escape; on success it is hurled 3d6×10 feet in a random direction.

Reverting to normal takes 1 minute during which the creature is incapacitated and cannot move; returning to cloud form also takes 1 minute. If the spell ends while a creature is flying in cloud form, it descends 60 feet per round for up to 1 minute and lands safely if possible, otherwise it falls the remaining distance.

The wind keeps fog, smoke, and other gases away; blocks Small-or-smaller flying creatures and objects and gaseous-form creatures; throws loose light materials upward; and automatically deflects ordinary arrows, bolts, and similar projectiles aimed through it, though very heavy projectiles are unaffected.

name: Wish
effectSummary: The basic, risk-free use duplicates any spell of 8th level or lower without needing that spell's requirements or costly components. Alternatively choose one listed effect: create one nonmagical object worth up to 25,000 gp and no more than 300 feet in any dimension; fully heal up to twenty visible creatures and end on them all effects removable by greater restoration; grant up to ten visible creatures resistance to one chosen damage type; grant up to ten visible creatures immunity to one spell or magical effect for 8 hours; or undo one roll made within the last round by forcing a reroll, optionally with advantage or disadvantage, then choose either result. You may ask for a greater unlisted effect, but the DM determines the outcome and it may fail, only partly succeed, or produce unforeseen consequences. Using wish for anything other than duplicating another spell causes stress: until your next long rest, casting any spell deals 1d10 unavoidable necrotic damage per spell level; your Strength becomes 3 if higher for 2d4 days, with each full day of rest reducing remaining recovery by 2 days; and there is a 33% chance you can never cast wish again.

name: Witch Bolt
components: M (a twig from a tree that has been struck by lightning)
effectSummary: Make a ranged spell attack against one creature within 30 feet. On a hit it takes 1d12 lightning damage and, while you maintain concentration up to 1 minute, you can use your action on later turns to deal 1d12 lightning damage automatically. The spell ends if you use your action for anything else, the target moves out of range, or it gains total cover. Each slot level above 1st adds 1d12 to the initial damage only.

name: Wither and Bloom
components: M (a withered vine twisted into a loop)
effectSummary: Choose a 10-foot-radius sphere centered within 60 feet. Creatures of your choice there make Constitution saves, taking 2d6 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success; nonmagical vegetation withers. One creature of your choice in the area may spend and roll one unspent Hit Die and regain HP equal to the roll plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Each slot level above 2nd adds 1d6 damage and lets the healing target spend one additional Hit Die and add it to the healing roll.

name: Word of Radiance
effectSummary: Each creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet makes a Constitution save or takes 1d6 radiant damage. Damage becomes 2d6 at character level 5, 3d6 at 11, and 4d6 at 17.

name: Word of Recall
effectSummary: Instantly teleport yourself and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet to a sanctuary you previously designated. You and accompanying creatures appear in the nearest unoccupied spaces to the designated point. To designate a sanctuary, cast this spell in a place dedicated to or strongly linked with your deity; attempting to designate an unsuitable location has no effect. Casting without first establishing a sanctuary also has no effect.

name: Wrath Of Nature
effectSummary: Animate nature in a 60-foot cube centered within 120 feet for up to 1 minute. Grass and undergrowth become difficult terrain for your enemies. At the start of each of your turns, each enemy within 10 feet of a tree makes a Dexterity save or takes 4d6 slashing damage. At the end of each of your turns, one grounded creature you choose in the cube makes a Strength save or is restrained until the spell ends; it can use an action for a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC to escape. As a bonus action, launch one loose rock in the cube with a ranged spell attack; on a hit it deals 3d8 nonmagical bludgeoning damage and the target makes a Strength save or falls prone.

name: Wristpocket
effectSummary: Send one object you alone are holding, weighing no more than 5 pounds, into an extradimensional space for up to 1 hour. While concentrating, you can use an action to summon it to your free hand and an action to return it to the pocket space. If it remains stored when the spell ends, it appears at your feet.

name: Zephyr Strike
effectSummary: For up to 1 minute, your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. Once before the spell ends, you can give yourself advantage on one weapon attack on your turn; on a hit it deals an extra 1d8 force damage. Hit or miss, after making that empowered attack your walking speed increases by 30 feet until the end of the turn.

name: Zone of Truth
effectSummary: Create a 15-foot-radius sphere centered within 60 feet for 10 minutes. A creature entering for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a Charisma save. On a failure, it cannot knowingly speak a deliberate lie while in the area. You know whether each creature succeeds or fails. Affected creatures know they are constrained and may remain silent or answer evasively as long as they do not deliberately lie.
